errors.text_span: 并在约第15个epoch后趋于平稳
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate oversimplification. Both curves are still clearly rising after epoch 15 and only begin to plateau around epoch 23-25.
The training set accuracy (blue line) continues to rise and stabilizes at a value above 0.9, not 0.85.
The validation set accuracy (orange line) stabilizes at approximately 0.85, not 0.82. The value is around 0.82 at epoch 15, but it continues to rise before stabilizing.

errors.text_span: 表明模型在训练集上表现略优于验证集
